contexts.text: A sign is called a mark ().
This is the characteristic sign; let everyone examine himself according thereto.

In order that a man may know the nature of... a life of pride, avarice, etc... let him make for himself the character of any one of them... On the other hand, if he makes for himself the character of love and of charity...
To have the mark (of the beast) upon the hand and upon the forehead () = to acknowledge all things of whatever quality.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. If good were the mark and the essential of the Church... NJHD 246:4.

To give them a mark upon their right hand and upon their foreheads () = that no one is acknowledged as a Reformed Christian except him who receives that doctrine in faith and life... A mark = the acknowledgement that he is such; and also the profession that he is.

That no one might buy or sell if he has not the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name () = that no one is allowed to teach from the Word, thus not to be installed into the priesthood, to be decorated with the laurel of tutorship, to be invested with a doctor's cap, and to be called orthodox, except him who acknowledges this doctrine, and swears to the belief and love of it; or of that which is in agreement, or of that which is not at variance with it.
To receive his mark upon the forehead and upon the hand () = to receive the doctrine of justification and salvation by faith alone, to confirm it, and to live according to it. AR 637. AR 679.
His mark = the acknowledgement of that faith.
On which his whole character depends...
The mark of thought is...
Besides this characterizing mark...
These three things are the characterizing testimonies...
These are the marks, witnesses, and signs...
On the marks of good Spirits.
In families there is always something characteristic, which distinguishes one from another, and which reigns in its General...
On magic characters.
The characters of the words (in the copy of the Word) were alike; but they did not understand them; they were in the celestial style.
(The vowels) are annexed by means of marks above and below.
The other book... was written with mere marks according to the method used in the Celestial Kingdom...
On a characteristic mark of the evil and of the good.
They were not foreign characters; but the style was in Roman letters.

To give them a mark upon their right hand and upon their foreheads () = a testification of acknowledgement that they are of the Church, and in the so-called goods and truths of that faith. A mark = a sign or testification of acknowledgement. AE 886.
That no one might buy or sell if he has not the mark of the beast () = a prohibition against anyone's learning or teaching anything but what is acknowledged and thence received in the doctrine.

To receive his mark upon the forehead or upon the hand () = to receive from acknowledgement the evils of doctrine concerning faith alone as goods of the Church, and the falsities thereof as truths of the Church.
His mark = the acknowledgement thereof.

Upon the men who had the mark of the beast, and upon those who adored his image () = those who acknowledge faith alone and its doctrine, and live according to it... His mark = the acknowledgement, reception, and testification thereof.
